items.docs:
Lists both Tenable-provided folders and the current user's custom folders.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Creates a new custom folder for the current user. There is a rate limit of 10 folder creation requests per minute.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The ID of the folder to edit.

items.docs:
Renames a folder for the current user. You cannot rename Tenable-provided scan folders or custom folder that belong to other users (even if your account has administrator privileges).
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The ID of the custom folder to delete. Use the [GET /folders](/reference#folders-list) endpoint to determine the ID of the custom folder you want to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes a folder. If you delete a folder that contains scans, Tenable Vulnerability Management automatically moves those scans to the Trash folder. You cannot delete Tenable-provided folders or custom folders that belong to other users (even if you use an administrator account).
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Lists the current user's custom folders.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Creates a new custom folder for the current user.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Renames a folder for the current user. You cannot rename Tenable-provided scan folders or custom folders that belong to other users (even if your account has administrator privileges).
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Deletes a folder. If you delete a folder that contains scans, Tenable Web App Scanning automatically moves those scans to the Trash folder. You cannot delete Tenable-provided folders or custom folders that belong to other users (even if you use an administrator account).
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).
